checked_claim: PIT 1.30.2 CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY maps each listed integer comparison jump opcode to one substitution: <= to <, >= to >, > to >=, and < to <=. It changes the comparison instruction, retaining compared values; it does not replace >= with <, alter a literal, or provide == and != alternatives.

PIT's basic concepts describe CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY as changing >= to > in bytecode and explain that tests must fail in the presence of a behavior-changing mutant; a test kills a mutation when it catches it.
